description: This file contains Makefile macros and shell script snippets for building, packaging, and managing dependencies of software packages in the OpenWrt build system. It defines functions for package wildcard generation, dependency handling, and package installation procedures for different package formats (ipkg and apk).

methods.name: gen_package_wildcard
methods.description: Generates a wildcard pattern for package files based on package name and ABI version.

methods.name: remove_ipkg_files
methods.description: Removes specified ipkg or apk package files for a given package.

methods.name: BuildPackVariable
methods.description: Defines package build variables and commands based on package name, variable name, suffix, and script flag.

methods.name: FixupReverseDependencies
methods.description: Fixes reverse dependency links for a package.

methods.name: FixupDependencies
methods.description: Fixes dependency links for a package.

methods.name: CheckDependencies
methods.description: Checks for missing dependencies of a package, compares with provided libraries.
